overview: Mysuru is a royal city with a grand illuminated palace, a well-run zoo and gardens; Bengaluru adds Wonderla, science museums and good food. Easy to reach by the fast Vande Bharat or Shatabdi train.
fit: Excellent for both: zoo, palace lights, a water park and hands-on museums.
season: Mild all year (20–30°C). October has the Dasara festival with the palace lit every night (very crowded). April–May are warm; June–September brings light rain.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Mysuru on Vande Bharat or Shatabdi (via Bengaluru)
Chennai to Bengaluru, then road or train to Mysuru

gettingAround: Cabs and autos in Mysuru; metro and app cabs in Bengaluru.

todo.title: Mysore Palace
todo.why: Huge, ornate palace; lit with 1 lakh bulbs on Sundays and holidays 7–7:45 pm

todo.title: Mysuru Zoo
todo.why: One of India's best zoos, walkable
todo.book: Go at opening (8:30 am); closed Tuesdays

todo.title: Rail Museum Mysuru
todo.why: Old engines and a mini train ride

todo.title: Wonderla, Bengaluru
todo.why: Water and dry rides; separate kids' zone
todo.book: Book online for discount; weekdays are quieter

food.note: Red chutney inside; ask for less spice
